### 5‑Day Instagram Content Plan for Faded Archive Launch

| Day | Post Type | Visual/Theme | Caption Angle | Hashtags |
|-----|-----------|--------------|---------------|----------|
| **Day 1** | **Launch Teaser** | Logo on a subtle, vintage‑style background with a “Coming Soon” overlay | “Something… vintage‑ish… is landing soon. Stay tuned.” | #FadedArchive #TeeShop #ComingSoon |

| **Day 4** | **Story + CTA** | Instagram Stories: poll (“Which colour do you want next?”) + swipe‑up link to shop | “Your vote counts—pick the next drop!” | #ChooseYourStyle #FashionCommunity |

> **Format notes:** 1080 × 1080 JPG/PNG for posts, 1080 × 1920 for Stories. Keep captions under 150 words. Use consistent brand font and color palette from day 1 logo.

### Quick recap of eBay UK fees for clothing

| Fee | How it’s calculated | Typical range |
|-----|---------------------|---------------|
| **Final Value Fee (FVF)** | 12 % of the sale price **(incl. shipping)** | £10–£15 per item for standard sellers |
| **Listing Fee** | £0.50 per item (or £1.60 per higher‑value “Featured” slot) | Flat fee, no minimum price |
| **PayPal/Bank Transfer Fees** | 3 % + £0.30 per transaction | Included in the seller’s overall cost |
| **Optional: Buyer Protection** | 1 % buyer‑insurance fee | • |

*All figures are approximate and exclude any promotional or discount features. Fees can vary with seller level, final‑value‑fee discounts, and promotional tools.*
